A1.justification: Both PDFs describe ArchCAD-400K and DPSS. Their text, equations, tables, figures and appendices are readable and support reliable comparison, including matching relocated and merged material.

before.justification: V1 reports original DPSS benchmark results, dataset-scaling and transfer experiments, qualitative comparisons, and per-category results in Appendix D.

after.justification: V3 retains original benchmark and scaling results and adds component ablations, inference-latency measurements and public-subset experiments.

M1.justification: The annotation pipeline and DPSS architecture remain unchanged: image and point encoders, adaptive fusion, transformer decoder and weighted classification/mask losses. The added activation-function wording in Section 5.2 explains the sigma operation already present in v1's equation.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same spotting tasks on FloorPlanCAD and ArchCAD-400K. V3 additionally evaluates a refined public subset described as preserving the original dataset structure; no distinct domain, population or task coverage is established.

E2.justification: The corresponding FloorPlanCAD and original ArchCAD-400K comparisons retain their baseline sets. The new latency and public-subset tables reuse CADTransformer, SymPoint and SymPointV2 rather than introduce another comparison method.

E3.justification: The original splits, sample counts, training budgets and prior-information settings are retained. V3 adds encoder/fusion controls, average-latency evaluation and training/evaluation on a public subset with revised preprocessing and annotations. Per-category IoU is no longer reported. The public subset's size and splits are unspecified.

E4.justification: V3 adds controlled tests of the primitive encoder, image encoder and adaptive fusion in Section 6.3/Table 5, plus computational-efficiency analysis in Appendix B.1. It removes v1's category-level PQ/IoU diagnostics in Appendix D. Transfer, scaling and qualitative comparisons are retained, with qualitative examples consolidated.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, significance tests or uncertainty bands. V3's average-latency results do not introduce accompanying replication or variability information.

E6.justification: Original benchmark scores remain unchanged, including DPSS PQ of 86.2 on FloorPlanCAD without priors and 70.6 on ArchCAD-400K. V3 adds concatenation/adaptive-fusion ablation PQs of 83.0/86.2, latency of 121 ms versus SymPointV2's 95 ms, and public-subset PQ of 82.9 versus 76.6. These subset scores use different data conditions. V1's per-category result table is removed.

T1.justification: The semantic/instance-label definitions, sampling and fusion equations, and weighted loss formulation are retained. Neither version supplies theoretical propositions or proofs, and v3 introduces no substantive mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The annotation-efficiency, dataset-scale/diversity and DPSS performance contributions remain unchanged in the abstract, introduction and conclusion. Dataset openness is qualified: v1 calls the dataset 'open' in its title, whereas v3 drops that qualifier and explicitly describes release of a refined public subset in Appendix B.2.

C2.justification: V3 adds interpretations of component complementarity and the accuracy/latency tradeoff. Appendix C explicitly acknowledges that DPSS cannot process an entire drawing in one pass and incurs high computational overhead. Appendix B.1 reverses the dataset attribution of the 3.0- and 10.1-point PQ advantages relative to its own Table 7.

D1.justification: V3 adds a repository link, public-subset release information, anonymization disclosures, 700×700 image resolution and confirmation of model convergence. It removes v1's SVG annotation-format example and accompanying implementation explanation. Existing hardware, optimizer and training hyperparameters remain, while the new subset's precise construction and evaluation details are incomplete.

R1.justification: Both versions cite the same 42 works and retain the same related-work coverage and positioning relative to previous datasets and symbol-spotting methods.

P1.justification: The seven-section main narrative is retained. V3 condenses selected introduction, annotation, method-overview and results passages, updates the title and affiliations, and groups v1 Appendices A–C into A.1–A.3 while reorganizing the evaluation appendices.

P2.justification: V3 substantially reorganizes the displays: v1 Figures 5–6 become Figure 4, qualitative Figures 9 and 12 become Figure 7, and ArchCAD-400K Tables 4–5 are merged. The SVG-format figure and per-category table disappear; ablation, latency and public-subset tables are added. Conference formatting also changes margins, figure sizing and caption placement throughout.

improvement.justification: The new component ablations supply previously missing evidence for DPSS's fusion design, while timing measurements and explicit whole-drawing limitations clarify practical costs. These are useful gains, but v3 removes category-level failure diagnostics, incompletely documents the public-subset protocol and introduces erroneous dataset attribution in the timing discussion. The net improvement is therefore limited, with the original benchmark findings retained.
